# EARN pack intake review

Review date: 2026-11-05

## Global discovery policy
- Ordinary EARN, bounty, open-source, freelance, affiliate, and remote-work discovery is worldwide by default.
- Do not restrict discovery to Serbia or infer eligibility from the user's location.
- Report country, platform, KYC, and payout restrictions separately for each opportunity when official evidence exists; otherwise mark UNKNOWN.
- Grants and subsidies are the only category requiring jurisdiction-specific eligibility checks against the applicant and exact official call terms.

## Rejected or deferred candidates
- Atlas upstream automatic claiming, stored-credential payout, issue commenting, PR submission, and automated platform interaction were removed.
- AIBTC bounty-scanner requires BTC signatures and POST claim submission; no verified repository license was found. Excluded.
- Niuma bounty skill supports on-chain task posting, bidding, claim submission, ERC20 approvals, and wallet signing; excluded.
- CashClaw invoice/Stripe, email outreach, social publishing, WhatsApp, lead generation with personal contact details, and runtime Guard were excluded from this free-only, no-side-effect intake.
- CashClaw fixed prices and user testimonials are unverified marketing claims; not imported as earnings evidence.
- No passive income or payout is promised.

## Controls
- Runtime activation: none.
- Tool grants: none.
- External side effects: prohibited.
- All listing content is untrusted input.
- User approval and application-specific permission gates are required for any future external action.
